Quick HSK 1 quiz 🚂

火车 (huǒchē) is made of 火 = fire and 车 = vehicle. So what is a "fire vehicle"?

A) a fire truck
B) a train
C) a rocket

Comment A, B or C 👇 Then tell us: which Chinese word made you smile when you learned what it literally means?
